title: BasicGamerz
description: Adds basic mods with default settings that enhance vanilla Minecraft visuals, making it look beautiful, while also adding smooth animations to gameplay, giving your overall experience a more lively and polished feel
body:
# 🎮 Basic Visual + Animation Modpack

Make your vanilla Minecraft look **beautiful, smooth, and alive** ✨  
This modpack adds **basic visual enhancements and smooth animations** without changing the core vanilla feel.

---

## 🌟 Features
- ✨ Improved visuals with shaders-like effects  
- 🎨 Better lighting and environment feel  
- 🕺 Smooth player & gameplay animations  
- ⚡ Optimized for better performance  
- 🎮 Keeps vanilla gameplay style intact  

---

## 📦 Mods Included
(All credits go to original creators ❤️)

- Sodium – Performance boost  
- Iris – Shader support  
- 

---

## ⚠️ Important
This is a **modpack**, not a custom-made mod.

All mods included belong to their respective creators.  
I do not own any of these mods.

Please support the original developers by visiting their official pages.

---

## 📢 Community
Made with ❤️ for **Basic Army**

📺 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@NotBasicGamerzs  
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/VXMsxnmxqx  

---

## 🚀 Installation
1. Install Fabric/Forge (as required)  
2. Download the modpack  
3. Put mods into your `mods` folder  
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

---

🔥 Enjoy a more beautiful and animated Minecraft experience!
